column4: PSG-VA-0001,Remote work passage,Remote work has removed the daily commute for millions of employees and given them more control over their schedules. Many report better focus and less stress. However, teams that work remotely can drift apart: informal conversations disappear and new members find it harder to learn how the team works. Organisations that succeed with remote work make deliberate efforts to keep people connected, such as regular video check-ins, written documentation and occasional in-person meetings."
